scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace src-ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace src-ui && eslint . --fix --cache && markdownlint-cli2 --fix
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:check --workspace src-ui && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && markdownlint-cli2
scripts.icons:check: vitest run --project gates tests/app-icons.test.ts -t '^committed icons match the brand$'
scripts.test: npm test --workspace src-ui && vitest run --project tooling
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace src-ui -- --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=html && vitest run --project tooling --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=html
scripts.coverage:json: npm run coverage --workspace src-ui && vitest run --project tooling --coverage
scripts.test:backend: npm run coverage:backend-unit && npm run test:backend-integration && npm run test:e2e-smoke && npm run coverage:backend-report
scripts.test:probes: npm run coverage:json && npm run coverage:backend-unit:json && vitest run tests/mutation-probes.test.ts
scripts.coverage:backend-unit:json: bwrap --unshare-net --dev-bind / / --proc /proc vitest run tests/backend-coverage-stages.test.ts -t '^unit JSON coverage$'
scripts.test:backend-probe: bwrap --unshare-net --dev-bind / / --proc /proc vitest run tests/backend-coverage-stages.test.ts -t '^backend probe coverage$'
scripts.test:e2e-probe:stages: vitest run tests/backend-coverage-stages.test.ts -t '^reset backend probe$' && dbus-run-session -- xvfb-run -a vitest run tests/e2e-smoke.test.ts -t '^the bundled native shell' && vitest run tests/backend-coverage-stages.test.ts -t '^backend JSON report$'
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint:check && npm run docs:check && npm run icons:check && npm run build && npm run test:probes && npm run coverage:verify && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
